scope: One synthetic Gmail-to-Outlook message, one Sales-owned Odoo sandbox opportunity, project-owned delegated Outlook OAuth, accelerated local n8n schedules

ai_and_review.resolution: A scoped lab operator supplied the owner and a source-backed acknowledgement task; no price was invented

verification.receipt_check: one matching recent message in recipient Junk; read-only

limits: The approver was a separate automated lab identity, not a human acceptance session. The reply acknowledged the pricing request; it did not provide an unverified price. Graph acceptance, Sent Items and recipient-folder arrival do not prove the message was read. The test does not enable general customer sending or 24-hour operation.
